name: Perdido Marine Supply
description:
Perdido Marine Supply was born from a lifelong love of the water. Owner Doug Adams has spent most of his life in the marine world—working on boats, learning equipment inside and out, and helping fellow boaters make every outing better than the last. After years in the corporate world, Doug felt the pull to return to what had always brought him the most joy. In 2018, he and his family took that leap, opening a business built on passion, hands-on experience, and the desire to serve the boating community with honesty and heart.

Family-owned and family-operated, Perdido Marine Supply has proudly served Pensacola and the greater Escambia County area with a focus on quality products, reliable service, and genuine hometown care. Over the years, trolling motors naturally became our specialty—not just because Doug knows them better than anyone, but because he truly loves helping customers get the performance and reliability they need on the water. From installations and repairs to helping boaters choose the perfect setup, we're committed to making sure your time on the water is smooth, safe, and enjoyable.

Today, the Adams family—led by Doug himself—continues to run the shop with the same values it was founded on: craftsmanship, integrity, and a commitment to customer satisfaction. Whether you're looking for trolling motor expertise, marine electronics, accessories, fishing supplies, audio systems, life jackets, or friendly guidance from people who care, Perdido Marine Supply is here to help.

Welcome to Perdido Marine Supply—where family values, deep knowledge, and a lifelong passion for boating come together.
